nodes.description: Owned.contractOwner: privileged owner address set in the constructor from msg.sender.
Owned.pendingContractOwner: two-step ownership transfer target; anyone matching it can claim ownership.
OracleMethodAdapter.oracles: mapping(bytes4 => mapping(address => bool)) granting oracle rights per selector.
ATxAssetProxy.latestVersion: implementation contract that receives all proxied logic.
ATxAssetProxy.pendingVersion: proposed implementation awaiting the freeze-time.
ATxAssetProxy.pendingVersionTimestamp: block.timestamp when the upgrade was proposed.
ATxAssetProxy.platform: immutable platform contract holding balances and allowances.
ATxAssetProxy.smbl: asset symbol used when querying the platform.
GroupsAccessManager.membersCount: iterable membership counter.
GroupsAccessManager.groupsCount: iterable group counter.
PendingManager.accessManager: external GroupsAccessManager used for all membership checks.
PendingManager.authorized: contracts allowed to enqueue pending transactions.
PendingManager.policiesCount: number of registered policy rules.
PendingManager.txCount: number of pending multisig transactions.
DataController.withdrawal: address allowed to call changeAllowance.
DataController.assetAddress: asset allowed to call withdrawFrom/depositTo/updateCountryHoldersCount.
DataController.serviceController: controller used to resolve proxy and pending manager.
DataController.allowance: mapping(address => uint) withdrawal allowance per holder.
DataController.holdersCount: iterable holder counter.
DataController.countriesCount: iterable country counter and limit source.
ServiceController.pendingManager: multisig authority used by MultiSigAdapter.
ServiceController.profiterole: fee destination address.
ServiceController.treasury: treasury address.
ServiceController.proxy: ERC20 proxy address; considered a trusted service.
Owned constructor: contractOwner = msg.sender.
Owner-only selfdestruct routine.
Owner-only step one of the ownership handover.
Step two of the ownership handover, called by the pending owner.
Modifier that silently returns when msg.sender is not contractOwner (silent-failure access control).
Owner-only registration of oracle addresses per selector.
Owner-only removal of oracle entries.
Payable fallback that forwards msg.value and msg.data to the current implementation.
One-shot initialization of platform, symbol and name.
Public entry that forwards a referenced transfer.
Implementation-only transfer executed on the platform; guarded by onlyAccess(_sender).
Allowance transfer entry that delegates to the implementation.
Implementation-only allowance transfer on the platform.
Approval entry that delegates to the implementation.
Implementation-only approval write on the platform.
Asset-owner-only upgrade proposal; stores block.timestamp as the freeze-time start.
Unrestricted finalization of an upgrade after the freeze-time.
Asset-owner-only cancellation of a pending upgrade.
Internal helper casting latestVersion to ATxAssetInterface.
Internal helper forwarding msg.sender as _sender to the implementation.
Owner-only registration of a voting member.
Owner-only swap-and-pop removal of a member.
Owner-only creation of a voting group.
Owner-only batch add of users to a group.
Owner-only batch removal of users from a group.
Owner-only policy creation/update; recomputes group accept/decline limits.
Owner-only policy removal with swap-and-pop.
Authorized-only enqueue of a new pending multisig transaction.
Owner-only removal of a pending transaction.
Vote acceptance; trusts the external access manager for authorization.
Vote decline; trusts the external access manager for authorization.
Public entry that revokes the caller's own vote.
Internal vote revocation accounting.
Internal multisig gate: queries/creates a pending transaction in the PendingManager.
Withdrawal-only allowance update validated against the external token balance.
Asset-only decrease of the holder day/month limits.
Asset-only increase of the holder day/month limits.
Oracle/owner registration of a new holder and country linkage.
Asset-only update of the per-country holder count with an assert on the limit.
Adds an emission provider after multisig confirmation.
Multisig-gated change of the profiterole address.
Multisig-gated change of the treasury address.
Multisig-gated change of the pending manager that authorizes future changes.
Multisig-gated registration of a side service address.
Owner-only sweep that transfers arbitrary ERC20 balances held by the contract.
Oracle/owner change of a country maximum holder number.
Caller controlled value used for ownership, oracle, member and multisig authorization decisions.
Miner controlled timestamp used as the upgrade freeze-time source and comparison basis.
suicide(msg.sender) in Owned.destroy sends the whole contract balance to the caller.
ATxAssetProxy fallback performs a value-bearing external call with raw msg.data to the implementation contract.
ERC20Interface(token).transfer(_to, balance) on an attacker/owner supplied token address, ignoring the return value.
External call platform.proxyTransferWithReference executing the actual balance move.
External call platform.proxyTransferFromWithReference executing the allowance transfer.
External call platform.proxyApprove writing the allowance on the platform.
External calls PendingManager.hasConfirmedRecord/addTx on an owner controlled manager address.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes contractOwner in the Owned constructor, seeding the privileged account.
Owned constructor writes state variable contractOwner.
claimContractOwnership requires pendingContractOwner == msg.sender before the handover.
claimContractOwnership moves pendingContractOwner into contractOwner.
onlyContractOwner modifier gates destroy().
destroy() executes suicide(msg.sender), moving the whole balance.
msg.sender is the beneficiary passed to suicide.
changeContractOwnership is restricted to the current owner through onlyContractOwner().
changeContractOwnership writes pendingContractOwner.
parameter _to flows into changeContractOwnership.
addOracles is guarded by onlyContractOwner.
removeOracles is guarded by onlyContractOwner.
addOracles sets oracles[_sig][_oracle] = true, granting selector level privileges.
removeOracles deletes entries from the oracles mapping.
parameter _signatures flows into addOracles.
parameter _oracles flows into addOracles.
parameter _to flows into transferWithReference.
parameter _value flows into __transferWithReference.
parameter _sender flows into __transferWithReference.
onlyAccess(_sender) compares getLatestVersion() with msg.sender, so the caller picks the sender argument.
onlyAccess gate on __transferFromWithReference depends on msg.sender.
onlyAccess gate on __approve depends on msg.sender.
__transferWithReference calls platform.proxyTransferWithReference.
__transferFromWithReference calls platform.proxyTransferFromWithReference.
__approve calls platform.proxyApprove.
transferWithReference forwards into _transferWithReference.
_transferWithReference calls the implementation __transferWithReference and injects msg.sender.
_transferWithReference uses msg.sender as the _sender of the implementation call.
transferFrom calls __transferFromWithReference on the latest implementation.
approve calls __approve on the latest implementation.
_getAsset reads latestVersion.
the _getAsset result is used by the fallback.
the fallback forwards the caller address into an arbitrary implementation.
the fallback performs a value bearing external call with raw msg.data and msg.value.
the implementation contract can call back into the unguarded proxy fallback.
parameter _newVersion flows into proposeUpgrade.
proposeUpgrade uses now (block.timestamp) to start the upgrade freeze-time.
pendingVersionTimestamp = now makes the upgrade delay timestamp dependent.
proposeUpgrade stores pendingVersion.
commitUpgrade compares now against pendingVersionTimestamp + UPGRADE_FREEZE_TIME.
commitUpgrade promotes pendingVersion to latestVersion, which controls all proxied logic.
purgeUpgrade deletes the pending version.
registerUser is guarded by onlyContractOwner.
parameter _user flows into registerUser.
registerUser performs membersCount.add(1).
unregisterUser performs membersCount.sub(1).
createGroup is guarded by onlyContractOwner.
createGroup performs groupsCount.add(1).
deleteTx is guarded by onlyContractOwner.
deleteTx performs txCount.sub(1).
addPolicyRule is guarded by onlyContractOwner.
addPolicyRule recomputes totalAcceptedLimit with sub().add(); inconsistent prior limits make SafeMath revert.
removePolicyRule is guarded by onlyContractOwner.
removePolicyRule subtracts the removed group limits from the running totals.
addTx is restricted by onlyAuthorized which reads authorized[msg.sender].
msg.sender selects the authorized entry that permits addTx.
addTx performs txCount.add(1).
addTx computes _policyHash = keccak256(_sig,_contract).
the computed _policyHash is consumed by the policy lookups inside addTx.
accept identifies the voting member by msg.sender.
accept trusts the external GroupsAccessManager to authorize msg.sender for the group.
external call into GroupsAccessManager while vote accounting is in progress.
decline identifies the voting member by msg.sender.
decline relies on the external access manager for authorization.
external call into GroupsAccessManager during decline accounting.
parameter _key flows into accept.
parameter _votingGroupName flows into accept.
accept increments the local accepted counter before comparing it to the policy limit.
the incremented counter decides whether the guard becomes Confirmed.
revoke delegates to the private _revoke.
revoke passes msg.sender so a user can only revoke their own vote.
_revoke writes _guard.votes[_user] using the caller controlled user.
_multisig asks the PendingManager whether the transaction was already confirmed.
external call into PendingManager (hasConfirmedRecord / addTx) during multisig processing.
_multisig passes msg.sig and address(this) to the pending manager.
addEmissionProvider state change is gated by _multisig approval.
updateProfiterole is gated by _multisig.
updateTreasury is gated by _multisig.
updatePendingManager is gated by _multisig.
addSideService is gated by _multisig.
parameter _provider flows into addEmissionProvider.
parameter _block flows into the multisig key computation.
updatePendingManager rewrites pendingManager, the multisig authority for all later changes.
updateProfiterole rewrites the profiterole address.
updateTreasury rewrites the treasury address.
onlyWithdrawal compares msg.sender with the withdrawal address before changing allowance.
changeAllowance queries token.balanceOf(_from) on an external proxy contract.
changeAllowance writes allowance[_from] = _value.
parameter _from flows into changeAllowance.
parameter _value flows into changeAllowance.
updateCountryHoldersCount asserts the country max holder number is not exceeded before storing the count.
the local current holder count is compared against the requested country limit.
registerHolder performs holdersCount.add(1) and indexes the new holder.
the local _holderIndex computed in registerHolder keys the holders mapping.
registerHolder calls _createCountryId which uses the local _countriesCount.
withdrawnTokens is guarded by onlyContractOwner.
withdrawnTokens is callable by the owner identified through msg.sender.
withdrawnTokens calls ERC20Interface(token).transfer on an owner supplied token address.
the arbitrary token contract is executed while the sweep loop is running, allowing reentrancy.
